entries.german:
Personen P-Q

1-2: Klaus Peters, Pfarrer in Linden, 1982-84 3: Johanne Pfeiffer, Gemeindeschwester 4-6: Franz Ernst Pfisterer, Hilfsprediger in Siegerland, gefallen 1944 7: Peter Philipps, Pfarrer, 1985 8: Erich Pitsch, Pfarrer 9: Giselher Pohl, Pfarrer, 1969 10: Ernst Poensgen (1848-1925), Pfarrer und Superintendent 11: Werner Posner, Pfarrer in Krankenhausseelsorge, 1986 12: Reinhard Quellmann, Heimleiter des Altenzentrums Rosenberg, 1987
entries.english:
Persons P–Q

1–2: Klaus Peters, pastor in Linden, 1982–84; 3: Johanne Pfeiffer, parish nurse; 4–6: Franz Ernst Pfisterer, assistant preacher in Siegerland, killed in action in 1944; 7: Peter Philipps, pastor, 1985; 8: Erich Pitsch, pastor; 9: Giselher Pohl, pastor, 1969; 10: Ernst Poensgen (1848–1925), pastor and superintendent; 11: Werner Posner, pastor in hospital chaplaincy, 1986; 12: Reinhard Quellmann, director of the Rosenberg senior center, 1987
